items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We're interviewing Anthony Foster again, Chai Ni. Just a second. We're going to get started again. We were going to ask you, Chai Ni, about the way you would blow into a drum.
